title: Bridal Skincare Routine: A 30-Day Plan Before Your Wedding
ex: A 30-day bridal skincare routine: start new products in week 1, freeze your routine 2 weeks out, book the facial 7–10 days before, keep wedding week simple.
rt: Bridal Skincare Routine: 30-Day Plan | Mirc Glow
rd: Bridal skincare routine for 30 days: a week-by-week pre bridal plan at home, what not to start in the last 2 weeks, facial timing and a wedding-week routine.
quick: Start any new product in the first week, after a patch test, and change nothing in the last 14 days. Book your facial 7–10 days before, thread or wax a few days before, and in wedding week just cleanse, moisturise, wear sunscreen and remove make-up fully every night.
facts: 30 days is about one skin renewal cycle
Stop new products 2 weeks before the wedding
Book the last facial 7–10 days before
A more even-looking tone usually takes 8–12 weeks
